newsitem.title: UK: Laird gains on bullish statement, figures.
newsitem.headline: Laird gains on bullish statement, figures.

text.p: Laird Group Plc shares rose 29-1/2p to 374p on the back of strong results for 1996 and an upbeat statement on Thursday.

Analysts and market makers said Laird's pre-tax profit figure of 69.2 million stg topped estimates centring on 66-67 million. Laird's statement included news that profits in the first two months of this year were ahead of last year's.
"It's relief," said Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull analyst Zafar Khan.

"People were getting rather depressed about Laird's exposure in continental Europe which accounts for about 45-50 percent of sales. But the figures came out at the top end of the range and, although the statement is brief, what they do say is encouraging."
Khan picked out as particularly positive Laird's acquisition of additional capacity in Spain.
